_comment: Panels that still print a 'there are none' sentence when the read failed (#2829). Each entry names the issue carrying it and which of the two shapes the page has: one that destructures no `error`, or one that binds it and routes it to a toast that fades while the sentence stays. The list may only SHRINK: fix the page, delete its entry, and guard:panel-error-state turns the next one red.
